sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This AI Exception Management Policy establishes the framework for requesting, reviewing, and approving deviations from established AI governance standards for {system_name} operated by {org_name}. This policy applies to all AI components within the system boundary defined as {boundary} and ensures the continued protection of {cui_description} during exception periods.

sections.heading: 2. AI Exception and Waiver Process

questions.prompt: What is the formal process or tool used to submit an AI exception request?
Who is the designated authority responsible for approving AI waivers?
How often are approved AI exceptions reviewed for continued validity?

sections.body: To ensure operational flexibility without compromising security, {org_name} utilizes {exception_request_method} to document and track AI exceptions. All waivers must be formally authorized by {exception_approval_authority}. To prevent permanent policy degradation, all granted exceptions are subject to a review cycle performed {exception_review_cycle}.
